verdict.rationale: Rootly's schedule docs list overrides as a schedule feature alongside rotations, layers, restrictions, and previews, so the core override mechanism exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that an on-call engineer can take an override without admin involvement, or that shift-swap or coverage-request flows exist. Missing for 10: evidence of engineer-initiated overrides without admin rights, shift-swap functionality, coverage-request workflow, mobile or Slack self-service for schedule changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
